grade_items.feedback:
By and large, a well composed questionnaire demonstrating a good understanding of questionnaire design. Most of the required components are included and relevant, with clear and well-structured questions. Good application of relevant concepts and terminology. Presentation, language and formatting are professional. Overall, a well-designed and usable research instrument demonstrating good research skills.      
  However, the areas of improvement are :    
 
  Absence of the 2 main profile variables (i.e., gender and nationality group)    
  Abrupt introduction of Q 7  
  Sequencing of questions  
  Lack of aesthetic appeal of the questionnaire
